easyPrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and by sacrificing any other creature you control.
When the creature dies, Elas il-Kor's second ability triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to yourself.
Darien triggers, causing you to create a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Blasting Station and Elas il-Kor's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Elas il-Kor trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Repeat.
